Brief: Tell me about Alan Turing and elaborate on the impact of his work. — about Chemical castration

1. In the United Kingdom, computer scientist Alan Turing, famous for his contributions to mathematics and computer science, pleaded guilty in 1952 to a charge of gross indecency for engaging in homosexual acts and accepted chemical castration as a term of his probation, thus avoiding imprisonment.
2. Turing experienced side effects such as gynecomastia (breast enlargement) and bloating of the physique.
3. In 2009 British Prime Minister Gordon Brown issued a public apology for the "appalling" treatment of Turing after an online petition gained 30,000 signatures and international recognition.
